text:
michelle.j: Quick Q — we had a promo approved yesterday with a retro start date of Feb 1. Payroll cutoff was yesterday evening. How do we handle retro pay for an employee in Ireland?
leah.p: @michelle.j tag the manager's approval doc? For intl payroll we usually need local payroll to confirm tax codes.
michelle.j: Manager gave the signed evidence in the promo packet at 16:10 — too late for cutoff. Do we still put through retro on next cycle or do a separate off-cycle?
jamal: For EMEA we've mostly been doing a retro on next scheduled payroll unless backdate > 90 days. If taxes change we coordinate with ADP/local vendor.
people-ops: Hi team — short answer: run retro on next scheduled payroll (no off-cycle) unless the backdate exceeds 90 days or the local payroll vendor requires an ad-hoc payment. For Ireland specifically, we need the employee's updated tax info and the signed evidence in Lattice. Please ensure manager + manager's manager approval are present in the evidence thread.
people-ops: Quick checklist to include in the email to payroll@redwood.com:
• Signed promo packet (PDF) and Lattice link
• Manager approval timestamp and manager's manager confirmation
• Employee country and new band/level + backdate range
• Payroll ID / local tax ID if known
• Note if backdate > 90 days — include exec signoff attached
michelle.j: Can payroll run pick this up automatically if I email payroll@? What subject should I use?
payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Reminder — payroll intake closes 24 hours before run. Items received after cutoff are queued for the next run. Use subject: "Retro Request: [LastName, FirstName] — [Country]" and attach the signed packet.
leah.p: Also note: if the promotion changes equity targets, loop in comp-ops before sending to payroll.
michelle.j: Perfect — I'll send the email now with the packet and Lattice link. Thanks :thumbsup:
